description.fr-FR: Les paroles de Thérèse pendant sa dernière maladie, du 6 avril au 30 septembre 1897, telles que sa sœur Pauline, Mère Agnès de Jésus, les nota jour après jour dans son « Carnet jaune » : conseils sur la petite voie, confidences sur l’épreuve de la foi, dialogues avec ses sœurs à l’infirmerie, avec les souvenirs et l’attestation de Mère Agnès. Transcription du Carmel de Lisieux (édition du Centenaire).
description.en-US: Thérèse’s words during her last illness, from 6 April to 30 September 1897, as her sister Pauline, Mother Agnes of Jesus, set them down day by day in her “Yellow Notebook”: counsels on the little way, confidences about the trial of faith, conversations with her sisters in the infirmary, with Mother Agnes’s recollections and attestation. Transcription of the Carmel of Lisieux (Centenary edition).
description.pt-BR: As palavras de Teresinha durante a última doença, de 6 de abril a 30 de setembro de 1897, como sua irmã Paulina, Madre Inês de Jesus, as anotou dia após dia em seu «Caderno amarelo»: conselhos sobre o pequeno caminho, confidências sobre a provação da fé, conversas com as irmãs na enfermaria, com as lembranças e o testemunho de Madre Inês.

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Lisieux (Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire), notes of Mother Agnès de Jésus

sources.edition: Archives du Carmel de Lisieux, the transcription of Mother Agnès's Carnet jaune read from the json-cahiers data of /archive/carnet-jaune/ (sheets 1–196) and /archive/carnet-jaune-2/ (sheets 197 to the end, with the loose sheets headed "Autre"), sheet by sheet; the sayings are Mother Agnès's own dated notes. Only these two pages of the Derniers entretiens are on the site; the sayings recorded by Céline, Marie of the Sacred Heart and others are not.
sources.description: Mother Agnès's text only. Left out: the editors' cross-references ("Voir Paroles Retrouvées") with their stray brackets, and a word-processor error string ("Erreur ! Source du renvoi introuvable") that the site's transcription contains. The chapters follow the months of 1897; the daily dates are headings and Mother Agnès's numbering of the sayings under each date is kept in bold. A sentence that runs over a sheet is joined. Facsimile links are not kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Thérèse died in 1897 and Mother Agnès (Pauline Martin) in 1951; the notebook was first published in 1971. The site states no terms (its mentions légales page is empty, checked 2026-11-01). The US status of Mother Agnès's framing narration (URAA restoration) and of the sayings recorded by Céline (d. 1959) was not settled by the report; only the Carnet jaune is imported.
